Layoff / retrenchment
column2: Layoff is temporary inability to employ with the relationship intact; retrenchment is permanent termination for non-disciplinary reasons

column1:

Retrenchment / closure
column2: Retrenchment ends the worker's employment; closure ends the place of employment

column1:

Registration / recognition of a union
column2: Registration was voluntary under the repealed 1926 Act, which had no recognition machinery at all; recognition of a negotiating union arrived only with the IR Code, 2020

column1:
Give the discriminating line.

Interest on delay / damages for default
column2: Interest is compensatory and at a fixed rate; damages are penal and graded by the period of default. Both now sit in the Code on Social Security; the old s.7Q and s.14B labels belong to the repealed 1952 Act

Give the discriminating line.

Employee's / employer's contribution
column2: The employee's 12% goes wholly to provident fund; the pension diversion of 8.33% comes out of the employer's share

EDLI / EPS funding
column2: EDLI is funded by the employer alone; EPS additionally receives the Central Government's 1.16%

EPF / ESI applicability
column2: EPF at 20 or more with a ₹15,000 ceiling; ESI at 10 or more with a ₹21,000 ceiling

Bonus eligibility / calculation ceiling
column2: Two different ceilings: one decides who qualifies, the other the notional wage the bonus is computed on. Knowing only one answers neither version of the question. Now governed by the Code on Wages, with the figures notified — verify before quoting either

column1:

Gratuity / EPS qualifying service
column2: Gratuity needs 5 years, waived on death; EPS pension needs 10 years of eligible service

ID Act Chapter VA / VB
column2: VA covered 50–99 workmen; VB covered 100 or more and required prior permission. Historical only — the ID Act is repealed, and the IR Code sets the threshold at 300

column1:

column2: 100 under the old ID Act; 300 under the IR Code — for standing orders and for retrenchment permission. Since 21 Nov 2025 only 300 is law

Minimum wage / floor wage
column2: The minimum wage is fixed by the appropriate government for employments; the floor wage is a national statutory baseline introduced by the Code on Wages, below which no State may go

column2: Organised describes the enterprise; formal describes the worker's contract and social security — so a formal firm can employ informal workers

column2: CRR is held with the RBI and earns nothing; SLR is held by the bank itself in specified assets and does earn. The location of the reserve is the discriminator — F4.2

column2: Fiscal deficit is total expenditure less total receipts excluding borrowings. Omit those two words and the definition becomes trivially zero — F4.3

Fiscal / primary deficit
column2: Primary deficit is fiscal deficit minus interest payments, and is therefore smaller. Store the ordering as its own fact — T-20 — F4.3

GDP / GVA
column2: GVA = GDP minus product taxes plus product subsidies. Learn the sign convention, not the sentence — F4.1

column2: WPI excludes services entirely; CPI includes them, and CPI-Combined is the inflation-targeting index — F4.2

Devaluation / depreciation
column2: Devaluation is a deliberate official act under a fixed regime; depreciation is market-driven under a float

Provision / reserve
column2: A provision is a charge against profit and is mandatory even in a loss year; a reserve is an appropriation and needs profit — F6.2

Depletion / amortisation
column2: Depletion for wasting natural resources; amortisation for intangibles. Obsolescence is a cause of depreciation, not a parallel concept — F6.4

column1:
Give the discriminating line.

SLM / WDV
column2: SLM gives a constant charge and can reach zero; WDV gives a falling charge and never fully writes off — F6.4

Vouching / verification
column2: Vouching examines evidence for a transaction; verification confirms existence, ownership and value of an asset. Valuation sits inside verification, not vouching — F6.7

Internal check / internal audit
column2: Internal check is built into the division of duties; internal audit is a separate appraisal. Both sit inside internal control — F6.7

Qualified / adverse opinion
column2: Qualified means true and fair except for stated matters; adverse means not true and fair. They are not synonyms — F6.7

Cash flow / fund flow
column2: Cash flow tracks cash and equivalents; fund flow tracks changes in working capital — F6.5

Type I / Type II error

Stratified / cluster sampling
